user_statement: I've checked 21 modes, they either look nmerical (grid-scale) or have large spikes at the axis. I can see continuum crossing offsets but there is no point increasing accuracy if all these modes are going to be discarded anyway. So we can rellease R42 and F62 now. I've seen old E-shot modes already - these still need to be recalculated
review_scope: 21 changed-input TAE-like/mixed modes; release for production rules despite visible crossing offsets because these modes are unsuitable.
